dict.string: OneBar sets the volume of individual apps. macOS calls reading an app's audio "recording", which is why it asks — the audio is only played straight back out at the level you picked, and nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
OneBar watches a download you pick so Prevent Sleep can keep the Mac awake until it finishes.
